titleEn: Buy or renew a package by card

en: What packages are there and what do they cost?

steps: Wallet > Packages; Starter 690 EGP/mo (2 members, 300 credits), Growth 1,490 (5 members, campaigns, order in chat, 1500 credits), Pro 3,490 (15 members, API, priority support, 5000 credits); yearly = 9x monthly for 12 months
Pay on Kashier; package turns on when Kashier confirms
Runs one month and does NOT auto-renew; reminder a week before
edgeCases: Prices are DB seed values and may differ in prod (operator-editable? verify)
Early renewal starts the day the current ends
Package purchase switched off per account: not shown
Failed renewal -> past_due (7 days grace then marketing+replies pause)
No free plan (WA-NOFREE-1); store-included gives 2 members, no paid features
gaps: Plan comparison page for pre-sales not in product
assistantNote: money; payment is completed by the merchant on Kashier
